! Game text
| Before any starting cards are revealed, deploy on table with up to 5 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Cards under here do not count toward your deck limit. Thrice per game, may lose 2 Force to play a Defensive Shield from here, as if from hand. Permanent weapons do not cause forfeit = 0; characters hit by them are {{Errata hl|1=forfeit –3 (may not be modified)}}. || Before any starting cards are revealed, deploy on table with up to 5 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Cards under here do not count toward your deck limit. Thrice per game, may lose 2 Force to play a Defensive Shield from here, as if from hand. Permanent weapons do not cause forfeit = 0; characters hit by permanent weapons are {{Errata hl|1=forfeit = (printed forfeit -3)}}. || Deploy on table {{Errata hl|1=with 5 cards}} from outside your deck face-down under here.
